item.title: Flytipping after (unlicensed?) event - IkwerreFest, 9th August
item.description:
As reported on a local Facebook page, it appears that the (possibly unlicensed) IkwerreFestUK on Bostall Heath has left the remains of the celebrations strewn across the heath. Hopefully Greenwich Council will check whether a licence was granted for this event and whether the organisers are responsible for the fly-tipping.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Lodge Hill, Abbey Wood
